dimensions.label: Motion adherence
evidence: can you give me a quick sense of how many caregivers and clients you're managing right now?
dimensions.tip: Continue leading every call with discovery before pivoting to product, as done here.

dimensions.label: Discovery quality
evidence: how are you handling that today? Is it mostly caregiver notes, family calls, or something else?
dimensions.tip: Ask about decision process and budget/timeline explicitly, not just pain points, to round out discovery.

dimensions.label: Talk / listen balance
dimensions.tip: Aim for more listening — open with questions and let the buyer talk.

dimensions.label: Buying-signal detection & handling
evidence: I guess I'd want to see how the actual family-facing messaging works before I roll it out to my whole client base.
dimensions.tip: Probe explicitly for budget, timeline to decide, and who else needs to sign off rather than only identifying the ops manager as a stakeholder.

dimensions.label: Objection handling
evidence: My concern though is the "AI listening in" piece. Some of our clients and families are already a little wary of technology
dimensions.tip: After addressing the concern, confirm explicitly that it's resolved before moving to next steps.

dimensions.label: Proof-point fidelity
evidence: agencies reporting about 35% more billable hours
dimensions.tip: Keep anchoring only to published stats like this 35% figure rather than introducing unverified numbers.

dimensions.label: Next-step specificity
evidence: I'll follow up next week to find a time that works for both of your schedules
dimensions.tip: Lock a specific date/time on the call itself instead of a vague 'I'll follow up next week.'
